scripts.build: turbo run build && mkdir -p dist && (cp packages/agenty-bootstrap/bin/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.dev: turbo run build --filter=agenty-bootstrap && pnpm --filter agenty-bootstrap exec bun -e "const { join } = await import('node:path'); const { resolveArch, resolveOS } = await import('./scripts/target.ts'); const os = resolveOS(); const executable = join('bin', 'agenty-' + os + '-' + resolveArch() + (os === 'windows' ? '.exe' : '')); const child = Bun.spawn([executable, ...process.argv.slice(1)], { stdin: 'inherit', stdout: 'inherit', stderr: 'inherit', env: process.env }); process.exit(await child.exited);"
scripts.core:tidyup: cd packages/agenty-core && go fmt ./... && go vet ./... && go mod tidy
scripts.cli:dev: turbo run build --filter=agenty-core && pnpm --filter agenty-cli dev
